headline: DNA testing shows the rare grape Kolorko is Hungary's Furmint.
body: Testing by the Paşaeli winery and the grape geneticist José Vouillamoz identified the Marmara grape Kolorko as Furmint. The same work matched Çal Karası to Crete's Liatiko.
why: The native-grape story is now being checked by science. Some "Turkish" grapes turn out to be shared with neighbours.
